title: Item model + storage (data-access layer)
description: Pantry Item model and persistent storage behind a small data-access layer
spec:
1. Define the pantry Item model with fields: name (required), category, quantity (>= 0), unit, expiry date (optional), threshold (default 1), notes (optional), createdAt, updatedAt.
2. Persist items using a lightweight store that fits podex conventions (SQLite or JSON file), chosen once and kept swappable behind a small data-access layer under api/ (no direct storage calls scattered through routes/views).
3. Verify the data-access layer exposes create/read/update/delete/list operations and that IDs are stable and unique per item.
4. Verify a newly created item round-trips: create, then list/read returns the same field values with timestamps populated.
5. Verify the store persists across a server restart (data is durable, not in-memory only).
6. Follow Pode/PowerShell idioms; do not introduce a Node server, ORM, or SPA data layer.
